neighbours.label: the second '0' of ':00' in an on-the-hour clock time (8:00, 9:00), as in opening hours
fire: The library is open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 am to 6:00 pm.
Doors open at 7:00 and the concert starts soon after.
Breakfast is served between 6:00 and 9:00 every morning.
Our office hours are Tuesday and Thursday, 1:00 to 4:00.
Check-out time at the hotel is 11:00 am sharp.
Sunday service begins at 8:00 am in the main hall.
The pool closes at 9:00 pm on weekdays.
quiet: The library is open Monday to Saturday from 10:15 am to 6:45 pm.
Doors open at 7:30 and the concert starts soon after.
Breakfast is served between 6:15 and 9:45 every morning.
Our office is on the third floor of building 14.
Check-out time at the hotel is 11:45 am sharp.
Sunday service begins in the main hall after the bells.
The pool is 50 meters long and 25 meters wide.
